proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ x
  constructor
  · intro hx i
    rw [minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' ℚ hx]
    exact ⟨(minpoly ℤ x).coeff i, by simp⟩
  · intro H
    have hx : IsIntegral ℚ x := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x
    have h : minpoly ℚ x ∈ Polynomial.lifts (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) :=
      (Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts _).2 (fun i => by
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := H i
        exact ⟨n, by simp [hn]⟩)
    obtain ⟨q, hq, _, hm⟩ := Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic h (minpoly.monic hx)
    refine ⟨q, hm, ?_⟩
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_def, ← Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap ℚ, hq]
    exact minpoly.aeval ℚ x
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (x : K), IsIntegral ℤ x ↔ ∀ i, ∃ n : ℤ, (minpoly ℚ x).coeff i = n
